verdict.rationale: Grafana's documentation shows alerting on metrics and logs from multiple data sources, with notifications sent to Slack, PagerDuty, VictorOps and OpsGenie. A community user confirms SQL-based alerts can be "routed just like Prometheus alerts," and Grafana Cloud adds on-call escalation. However, the pack never documents notification grouping or silencing, and routing appears only in that one community comment and the escalation feature. Missing for 10: documented notification grouping, documented silencing/muting, first-party documentation of routing policies.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can alert on any telemetry signal with routing, grouping, and silencing of notifications

citations.quote: you create queries and expressions from multiple data sources, no matter where you store your data, giving you the flexibility to combine your data and alert on your metrics and logs in new and unique ways
enables you to query, visualize, alert on, and explore your metrics, logs, and traces wherever they're stored
Grafana will continuously evaluate and send notifications to systems like Slack, PagerDuty, VictorOps, OpsGenie.
The alert can be written in SQL and, with Grafana 8, routed just like Prometheus alerts.
escalate alerts to the people who are on call
